integrity: Infinite-support statements have analytic proofs. Finite numerical checks corroborate but do not establish them. Literature priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns covariance for homogeneous independent Bernoulli sequential/common-fatal shocks, not unconditional quadrant dependence or time-varying intensities. A related earlier full text was unavailable; an undated earlier preprint may exist.
title: Sharp covariance-sign transition in a discrete sequential–simultaneous shock model
